༄༅/ /zab mo gzhan stong dbu ma'i brgyud 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zab mo gzhan stong dbu ma'i brgyud 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru/ zab mo gzhan stong dbu ma'i brgyud 'debs/ rgyal ba sras bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan ye shes lnga ldan sku gsum dngos/ / brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi 'byung gnas te/ /'phags tshogs 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi gtso bo mchog /bcom ldan thub pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /thog med dus nas byang chub sangs rgyas kyang / /'gro ba'i don du rgyal sras tshul ston pa/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab chen por dbang bskur brnyes/ /mgon po byams pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes zhi ba'i 'od byed sa brnyes shing / /mi pham mgon po'i zhal lung bdud rtsi thob/ /'dzam gling 'di na theg chen bstan pa'i bdag /'phags pa thogs med= /gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin dang gnyis su med/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i bka' rnams thugs su chud/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyin byed gcig pur gyur/ /rgyal sras dbyig gnyen= /phra zhing rtogs dka' drang srong chen po'i lam/ /bde gshegs snying po'i legs bshad seng ge'i sgra/ /ring nas nub pa slar yang gsal mdzad pa'i/ /gaṅgā mai tri'i= /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba'i dri ma gtan nas spangs/ /brtul zhugs spyod mdzad a wa dhū tī pa/ /mi pham zhal gzigs phyogs kun rgyu ba'i tshul/ /dga' ba grags pa'i= /theg mchog gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ /tshangs spyod dpal gyis brgyan pa'i dge slong ste/ /gnas lugs zab mo'i don gzigs kha che ba/ /'byung gnas zhi ba'i= bgrang yas mkhas grub byon pa'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /dpag yas lhag pa'i lha yis byin gyis brlabs/ /mtha' yas gsung rab legs mkhyen rnal 'byor mchog /bram ze sadzdza na la= /bde mchog 'khor lo'i zhal gzigs mkhas pa'i phul/ /phyogs 'dir gzhan stong dbu ma'i sgra bsgrags shing*/ /dpe med grong du rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa/ /dga' lo tsā ba'i rdo rje'i zhabs la= /mi pham gzhung la mkhas pa'i phul du gyur/ /dbu ma'i lam las chos nyid zab mo gzigs/

/sdom brtson dam pa btsan rigs kha bo che/ /dri med shes rab= /dgra gnyen chags sdang spangs te gzhan yul byon/ /zab mo'i mdo dang rgyud sde du ma mkhyen/ /rgyal tshab byams pas rjes bzung la stod pa/ /dar ma brtson 'grus= /rang byung ye shes gcig car thugs la 'khrungs/ /zhal mthong kun yang lam sna zin par grags/ /snying po'i bstan pa gsal mdzad dol pa gnyan/ /ye shes 'byung gnas= /'phags mchog gnyis kyi dgongs pa gcig tu gzigs/ /theg chen mngon pa'i bstan pa gsal mdzad pa/ /byang chub skyabs dang gzhon nu byang chub ste/ /'jad ston sku mched= /sdom brtson chos skyong bran du 'khol ba po/ /sde snod 'dzin pa mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /phyag rdor zhal gzigs chos rje skyo ston pa/ /smon lam tshul khrims= /'phags pa mi g.yo mgon po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bka' dang bstan bcos mtha' dag thugs su chud/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /bcom ldan ral gri'i= /mang thos mthar phyin dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ /nyan bshad sgo nas bstan pa nyin mor mdzad/ /che dgus zhabs la btud pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /skyi ston 'jam pa'i dbyangs la=/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir nges don bstan pa'i bdag /'gran med dam pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /'jig rten dbang mgon po'i rnam 'phrul jo nang pa/ /kun mkhyen chen po'i= /blo gsal 'dus pa dam pa kun gyi rgyan/ /rig pa'i dbang phyug phas kyi rgol ba 'joms/ /mkhas mchog rnams kyi bla ma kun dga' dpal/ /nya dbon chos rje'i= /bla mas byin brlabs 'gro ba'i don chen 'grub/ /snying rje chen pos rgyal ba'i sras su chud/ /bde gshegs snying po'i don la nges pa 'khrungs/ /chos dpal mgon po'i= /'dul mngon rgya mtsho'i pha rol son nas kyang*/ /phyi ma'i dus na gzhung brgya smra ba'i mchog /dam pa'i spyod ldan byang chub thugs gnyis 'byongs/ /blo gros bzang po rgya mtsho'i=

/zab mo'i don la ting 'dzin brtan pa thob/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bur mngon sum gzigs/ / gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig pa'i don yod dpal/ /byams mgon gnyis par grags la= /mdo sngags gzhung lugs nges gsang kun gzigs nas/ /log smra mtha' dag yang dag rigs pas sel/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gnas lnga rig pa'i phul/ shākya mchog ldan= /mkhas mchog gang de'i gsung gi gsang ba las/ /nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i blo gros can/ /mkhas pa'i dbang phyug 'od gsal rdo rje'i thugs/ /don yod grub pa'i= /phyogs 'dzin spangs te dam pa'i chos kyi sgo/ /mtha' dag gsan zhing thugs su chud gyur nas/ /skal bzang yid kyi re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bor= /rgyal ba dges pa'i lam las mthar thug brnyes/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor dbang bsgyur ba/ /thar 'dod 'gro ba kun gyi ded dpon mchog /kun dga' rgyal mtshan= rlabs chen ting 'dzin gzungs dang smon lam gyi/ /chu gter dbus na ye shes ri bo'i rgyal/ /gzhan phan lha dbang tshogs bcas kun gyis bsten/ /grags ldan grub pa mchog la= /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pas/ /dus mthar bshes gnyen gzugs kyis 'gro don mdzad/ /dus rnams kun tu 'gro kun thar bar 'god/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa dang*/ /zhi lhag ting 'dzin nyams myong gong 'phel gyis/ /gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i dri ma kun bsal nas/ /dri bral bde gshegs snying po mngon 'gyur shog /phyis brgyud pa'i bla ma gzhan 'jug na yang dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyi gong du 'jug /dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyi shlau ka de rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs su bya'o/ /ye shes 'byung gnas kyi rjes la dge bshes tho gar gnam lde 'jug pa'ang yod mod mi dgos la/ 'di la brgyud pa'i khyad par gzhan 'jad ston sku mched kyi rjes la zhang mya ngan med/

lo mchog pa/ spang lo/ byang rtse/ nya dbon sogs ded kyang chog par grags la/ thogs med sku mched nye brgyud la mi dgos kyang lugs 'di'i shing rta'i srol 'byed yin pa'i phyir nges par 'jug dgos la/ rnam pa gcig tu ring brgyud la mos na sku mched kyi rjes su blau gros brtan pa/ yon tan blau gros/ gang spel/ dharma ma ti/ bha bya mi tra/ ratna mi tra/ shanti pa/ mai tri ba rnams brgyud pa yin pas de bzhin 'ded la/ yang gzhan stong gi lta ba'i rim pa klu sgrub nas brgyud pa ni/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ phyag na rdo rje/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ klu sgrub/ sha wa ri/ mai tri ba man chad sngar bzhin no/ /'di ni 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa thams cad kyi dgongs don gcig tu dril ba'i dmar khrid kyi brgyud pa yin la/ byams chos sde lnga so so'i khrid la brgyud pa tha dad du yod do/ /gzhan stong dbu ma'i lta khrid kyi brgyud 'debs 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /zhus dag/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/zab lam gzhan stong dbu ma'i brgyud 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 2 -- PAGE 3 -- PAGE 1 -
